title: Samplers are ODE solvers
hook: Euler, Heun and DPM++ 2M written in five lines each, then measured against the exact answer.

verified.claim: The update formulas are read from sample_euler, sample_heun and sample_dpmpp_2m.
heun uses Euler for the last step to sigma 0.
Measured orders are about 1 for euler and about 2 for heun and dpmpp_2m on the toy.
heun made 39 model calls at 20 steps with ComfyUI's own code.

unchecked: The toy is one-dimensional with a perfect denoiser. Rankings do not carry over to pictures.
The citations to Karras and to Lu et al. were checked at the first audit and not re-read this time.
